name: DXY-weak risk-on confirmed by extreme fear on the alt basket
rationale: Two independent cross-asset risk-on tells must agree: (1) the dollar is actively WEAKENING (loosening conditions) and (2) crypto sentiment is at an extreme-fear trough (bounded Fear&Greed). The conjunction is the thesis — a dollar-driven liquidity tailwind landing on washed-out sentiment in higher-beta alts. dxy is drifting so it is read ONLY as a cross (cross_down arms); Fear&Greed is bounded 0-100 so a fitted lt level is legitimate. DISCONFIRMER: a fear-greed-extreme-fear-only control (no dollar gate) must NOT match this on the Gate — if sentiment alone explains the edge, the dollar leg is redundant and this is a STOP. CONTROL EXIT on dxy cross_up isolates the dollar-weak window.
catalyst: dollar weakening (dxy cross_down) coincides with extreme-fear sentiment on the alt basket
